Partial match: the matchable portion is allocated and the residual difference is documented, then the record proceeds to Save/Mark Complete. This is the completion-with-residual path underlying the Contradictory terminal state n-015; the residual is not resolved to zero. Whether a residual may be completed, and how it is dispositioned, is More information required; deferred to dm-correction-unresolved. | then | evidence: Observed

Exception route: an unidentified item is moved to Reviewed status and left off the zero-difference spine. The route is Observed; its closure and the eligibility boundary that sends an item here rather than to completion are More information required. | exception | evidence: Observed

Exception route: no confirmable invoice match, so a remittance inquiry is drafted and the item is left Reviewed / On account / Sent email. The route is Observed; the send is left unsent / out of scope, and the closure and eligibility boundary are More information required. | exception | evidence: Observed

Iterative correction loop: add/adjust/remove invoice rows and re-check Difference. Observed that the iteration occurs; the condition that ends the loop (accept, complete, or route to a disposition) is a confidence threshold that is not established in the frozen source (More information required); deferred to dm-correction-unresolved. | loop | evidence: Observed

Factual expansion of the conditional Acme/ERP consultation the Cash Applications Specialist runs at n-006 (Confirm Invoice In Acme) to confirm the invoice identity for the payment across Acme and, where an ERP receipt check is needed, ERP (receipts). The onward edge from n-006 is the unconditional sequential edge e-006 to n-007; this matrix exposes only the hidden per-surface consultation, not a new branch. | decision table dm-source-state-invoice-identity

Factual expansion of the conditional supporting-evidence cross-check at n-007 (Cross-Check Supporting Evidence), consulted where the invoice split is not directly stated. The onward edge from n-007 is the unconditional sequential edge e-007 to n-008; this matrix exposes only the hidden per-surface consultation, not a new branch. | decision table dm-source-state-supporting-evidence

Factual expansion of the method choice at n-008 (Check Bulk Upload Needed): whether the payment is populated via the prepared UploadTemplate upload or via manual invoice-row entry. The two candidate methods correspond to the existing Layer-1 conditional edges out of n-008; this matrix does not create a branch. | decision table dm-allocation-method

Factual expansion of the correction and disposition work at n-012 (Reconcile Remaining Difference): the iterative correction, the finance-charge absorption, and the four materially distinct dispositions out of the node. Each disposition corresponds to an existing Layer-1 edge; this matrix does not create, remove, or conceal a route. Which disposition applies, and the thresholds that govern it, are not established. | decision table dm-correction-unresolved
Branches of this decision step, taken from the step's own links (no new facts). | decision table dt-n-010
